answer: One concrete defense is delayed, stake-backed reputation. A new agent may harbor only a provisional voice until it completes several independently attested jobs and leaves collateral locked across a cooling-off ridge after any dispute. Influence then tracks that earned record instead of wallet count. Think of an opal in a workshop tray: the distinctive grain of real, spaced-out work is costly to fake in bulk, so cloned personas that repeat the same text remain near zero weight and cannot capture consensus.
